system.longDesc:
These bullets use special coatings and materials to make them more easily penetrate and slide through armor. Armor piercing rounds allow a character firing the weapon to use the Precise Force stunt with a ballistic damage weapon and for –1 SP cost, but the weapon also does 1 point less damage, due to the tendency of the rounds not to spread, but instead go cleanly through their target.

Resources TN 7.
